layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-12 for section paddings. Create breathing room between technical elements.

grid_system.technical_borders: Use border-collapse techniques or raw 1px solid borders (border-zinc-800) to create a structured, engineering-focused look.

sections.name: Navigation
sections.surface: Crystal Glass: bg-zinc-950/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10. Do not use fully transparent background.
elements: Desktop Links: Home, About, Experience, Projects, Skills, Open Source, Contact
Mobile: Slide-down menu (not just a basic hamburger without animation)
Icons: GitHub, LinkedIn, X (using Lucide icons, 20x20)
Resume Button: Pill-shaped, border border-zinc-700 hover:border-indigo-500 hover:text-indigo-400 transition-colors

sections.name: Hero
sections.layout: Two-column grid (md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-center min-h-[85vh] pt-24)
elements: Column 1 (col-span-12 md:col-span-7): Availability badge (green dot + 'Available for new opportunities' in subtle pill), Name 'SAMARTH PATEL' in text-5xl md:text-6xl+ font-bold tracking-tighter, Headline 'Software Engineer building production-ready applications', rotating role text (Framer Motion).

Column 2 (col-span-12 md:col-span-5): Profile Image Card. Image constrained to max-h-[500px], grayscale filter by default, color on hover. Floating tech badges (Java, Spring Boot, React, Next.js, Node.js, AWS) using Framer Motion subtle floating.

sections.name: Engineering Highlights
sections.card_style: Flat background (bg-[#111113]), 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), border-indigo-500/50.
sections.content: 4 numerical or metric-based highlight cards (e.g., '100% Test Coverage', '5+ Production Apps') - keep it realistic, not fake.

sections.name: About
elements: 3 Sub-cards detailing background, engineering philosophy, and personal traits. Use subtle radial gradient backgrounds on hover.

sections.name: Experience
elements: Timeline nodes: Absolute positioned glowing dots
Content: Role, Company, Duration, Tech Stack tags (mono font)
Action: 'View Certificate' buttons (ghost style with external link icon)

sections.name: Featured Projects
sections.layout: Stack of 6 large cards, alternating layout (md:flex-row, then md:flex-row-reverse)
sections.card_style: Large containers (bg-[#111113] border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden).
sections.image_treatment: Browser-window style: top bar with 3 dots (red/yellow/green or monochrome zinc-700), bg-zinc-900, containing the screenshot. Image scales 1.05x on group-hover.
sections.content: Title (text-2xl), Description (text-zinc-400), Tech stack tags (pill, mono font text-xs text-indigo-300 bg-indigo-500/10), GitHub/Live links.

sections.name: Open Source
sections.content: Mono font heading. Message indicating 'Compiling open source contributions...' or a minimal card showing recent PRs.

sections.name: Skills
sections.layout: Grouped categories (Languages, Frontend, Backend, Databases, Cloud, Tools, Core Engineering)
sections.card_style: Category heading + flex wrap of tag pills. Borders subtle, hover text-white.

sections.name: Contact
elements: Column 1: 'Let's build something.' large text, email, location, social links.
Column 2: Form (Name, Email, Phone, Message). Inputs: bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800 focus:border-indigo-500. Submit button solid indigo.
Toasts: Use Sonner for form validation/success feedback.

sections.name: Footer
sections.layout: Massive top padding (pt-32 pb-8), minimal text
sections.content: Copyright, built with Next.js & Tailwind, subtle text-zinc-600.

visual_enhancers: Use a subtle CSS noise overlay (opacity-5) across the entire body to kill digital flatness.
Section reveals: framer-motion `whileInView` with opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0. Keep duration short (0.4s) to avoid lag.
Hover states: Ensure all interactive elements have specific text color and border changes on hover.

motion.role_text_rotation: AnimatePresence with y-axis flip or vertical slide for changing roles.
motion.project_hover: Scale image 1.05x, elevate card shadow, brighten border.
motion.prefers_reduced_motion: Wrap heavy animations in useReducedMotion checks.

accessibility.contrast: Text against #09090B or #111113 must exceed 4.5:1. Use #FAFAFA for headings, #A1A1AA for body.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-hidden='true' for decorative floating badges.
accessibility.test_attributes: Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, form inputs, and nav items (e.g., data-testid='hero-resume-button').

profile.description: Portrait of a young IT professional with headphones, confidently posing in dim lighting.
profile.usage: Hero section, cropped to portrait/card shape, grayscale with hover color.

project_echoowl.description: Graphs of performance analytics on a dark mode screen.

project_blog_platform.description: Computer monitor displaying code in a dark room.

project_group_chat.usage: Featured Projects - Group Chat Extension screenshot

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize standard Shadcn components for inputs, buttons, and toasts (Sonner).
Use lucide-react for all standard icons.
Do not build fake percentage bars for skills. Use pill layouts.
Build custom HTML/Tailwind structures for the Bento grids and Project Cards instead of forcing a generic Card component.
Implement Framer Motion for the rotating text in the hero and section scroll reveals.
Ensure 'browser window' mockups for project images use basic divs (rounded-t-lg, bg-zinc-900) with 3 colored or monochrome dots.
Create JS/JSX files where applicable. Adhere strictly to the defined #09090B background and #FAFAFA/#A1A1AA text palette.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center align the app container text by default. Keep it left-aligned for reading flow.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop-blur-xl and semi-transparent backgrounds for sticky headers, never fully transparent.
Avoid using generic AI emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡.
Avoid universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties like transition-colors or transition-transform.
Ensure generous spacing: p-8, p-12, py-24 for distinct sections.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., in the Contact form).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
